note: First match wins. A prompt that OPENS with a heading naming a brief, spec or requirements document is the build that document describes, whatever words appear inside it: 23 Sep, a greenfield build read as a bug fix because its heading said "Tech stack (fixed)". A prompt that opens by asking to build something is a feature before anything else; a consolidation is a refactor before a bug fix. Patterns run on the first 4 KB of a prompt, lower-cased. Only the rule id is stored, never the text. Labels feed reports; no routing decision reads them.
